title: Matches and tournaments | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Matches and tournaments
hero.lead: The fixture list combines a team’s matches and tournaments by season and status. Each card opens the match with match plan, events, videos, timings and, where enabled, a public live ticker.

body:
Filter fixtures

  1. Choose the playing year under Season. Kaderblick starts with the current season, so a populated demo can initially appear empty there.
  2. If you access several teams, a team filter appears. All teams combines them.
  3. For one selected team, Fixture list with a PDF icon opens that team and season as a PDF.

Overview sections

Matches and tournaments appear together in three collapsible sections. The heading count includes both.

  • Live: currently running matches and tournaments. Match cards provide Add event when Quick Events are available to your account.
  • Upcoming matches: future matches and tournaments.
  • Completed matches: finished matches and tournaments with results.

A match card shows competition or type, home and away team, score or versus marker, date, time, venue and weather. The location icon opens a map link when coordinates exist; the weather icon opens details. Authorised people can also share an announcement or result poster.

Create a match or change its appointment

The fixture list has no creation action. Create or edit the match in Calendar. Choose the Match event type and enter appointment, teams, competition, venue, meeting point, invitations and other offered data. After saving, it appears in the appropriate season.

Read match details

The header shows home and away team, current or final score, competition, date, time, venue and weather. Back to overview returns to fixtures; for a tournament match it returns to the tournament.

  • Live marks a running match.
  • Finish match appears only with match permission and asks for confirmation.
  • Synchronise with fussball.de appears only when a fussball.de address is stored.
  • A completed match can produce a result poster; a future match an announcement.

Public live ticker

Only accounts allowed to manage it see Public live ticker.

  1. Enable it to generate a public link.
  2. Select Open to check it or Copy link to share.
  3. Disable it to make the public view unavailable.

Without sign-in, it shows score and events. Player, coach, video and line-up data are not published there.

Match plan and line-ups

This section appears with read or management access. Authorised coaches set the starting formation, plan later formations for substitutions or changes, load and save templates and manage tactics. Release to players controls player visibility. See Line-ups for full instructions.

Match events

The chronological log separates home and away sides and contains phase markers such as first half, half-time, second half and end, plus recorded types, players and minutes. The verified match includes goals, assists, shots on target, corners, cards and substitutions.

  • Add event appears only with permission.
  • Pencil and bin edit or delete an event after confirmation.
  • A substitution names players going off and on; injury substitutions are marked.
  • Linked video clips can be expanded at the event.
  • During a live match, the Quick Event panel provides fast entry.

Videos

The collapsible section shows count and videos. Thumbnail or name opens playback. With video permission, add, edit or delete video and create an edit list. From playback, create an event at the current video position. Further tools are under Videos and analysis.

Request supporter access for a team

Add event and Add video remain visible on a match page when you lack editing access. Selecting either opens Request supporter access instead of the editing form.

  1. Check the team named in the request.
  2. If several teams are available, select the team and optionally add a short note.
  3. If exactly one team is available, Kaderblick submits the request for that team directly.
  4. An existing pending request shows its team and date and cannot be submitted again.
  5. Kaderblick sends a notification after approval or rejection.

The responsible club or team administration processes it under Users and assignments on the Supporter requests tab. Approval applies to the selected team and enables its permitted match-event and video actions.

Match timings

Without edit permission, stored values are read-only. With permission, save half duration from 1–90 minutes, break from 0–60 and added time for each half from 0–30. These values affect event timing and Quick Events.

Personal matchday

Attendance, meeting point, car pools, tasks and the coach response overview are explained under My matchday. Help-out invitations and general availability are under Help out.

Import and tournament

  • fussball.de import checks teams, players, matches and events before importing.
  • A tournament card opens its schedule; match details return to the tournament.

Differences by access

  • Players and parent relationships: see released matches, events and match plan; personal attendance is under My matchday.
  • Coaches: in the verified demo receive match-plan, event, video, live-ticker and timing actions for their team.
  • Supporters: may use Quick Events. If event or video permission is missing for a match, Kaderblick opens the Supporter access request instead.
  • Administration: sees teams and matches in its scope; each action is controlled by permissions delivered for that match.
